svg.title: What a Colocation Quote Hides
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-colocation-quote-buckets; chapter number: 4; title: What a Colocation Quote Hides; subtitle: Reported cost ranges beyond the power line; chart type: stacked_comparison; total range: Four cross-connects alone run $2,000 to $6,000 upfront before monthly charges; buckets: label: Cross-connect install (per link); low: 500; high: 1500; notes: One-time installation fee per cross-connect.; label: Cross-connect monthly (per link); low: 100; high: 300; notes: Recurring charge after installation.; label: Remote hands (per hour); low: 150; high: 350; notes: Billed hourly for on-site work.; label: Retail homelab colo quote (per month); low: 350; high: 900; notes: Retail quotes that pushed Techno Tim into a split-cost rack.; caption: Power dominates, with colo billing $150+ per provisioned kW-month against $50 or less DIY, but the line items around it add up fast.; assumptions note: Buckets carry different billing periods and are not summed; ranges are as quoted by each practitioner.; note: Sources: IPTP Networks (3EnjHW-36GI), Techno Tim (zbkqRPIUYAo), Alec Glover (TZp1yBea0o4).
